summary: Round A iteration smoke tests for Rivalo: object storage uploads, in-app notifications, branded transactional emails. 12/13 backend checks pass. 1 missing notification (new_applicant) on apply. Frontend smoke (bell, dropdown, file uploader on /post, login flow) all pass.
passed: Approve flow pushes 'approved' notifications to selected freelancers
Approve flow pushes 'rejected' notifications to non-selected applicants
Submit flow pushes 'submission' notification to client
Full project lifecycle works: create project -> mark paid (mongo) -> apply -> approve -> submit -> pick-winner
Login -> /dashboard navigation clean; dashboard tabs render
Header notification bell present (data-testid=notification-bell-btn); dropdown opens and shows latest notification (e.g. 'New submission')

failed.issue: POST /api/projects/{id}/apply does NOT push a 'new_applicant' notification to the project owner. Spec explicitly requires it. apply_to_project() in /app/backend/server.py (~line 401-426) inserts the application but never calls push_notification(project['client_id'], 'new_applicant', ...). After freelancer applied, client's /api/notifications still returned items:[] unread:0 (verified twice).
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/projects/{pid}/apply with freelancer token -> 200; immediately after, curl GET /api/notifications with client token -> {"items":[],"unread":0}. Other notification kinds (approved/rejected/submission/won) all worked in the same run.

action_items: In /app/backend/server.py apply_to_project (~line 425), after db.applications.insert_one(app_doc), add: await push_notification(project['client_id'], 'new_applicant', 'New applicant', f"{user.get('name','Someone')} applied to {project['title']}", f"/projects/{project_id}"). Optionally also send a branded email via send_email_async to project owner using email_shell.
notes: Resend in sandbox: only verified that send_email_async invocation paths exist in approve/pick-winner (per spec), no delivery verification needed. Frontend submission FileUploader (in-progress project view) and approved-freelancer submission flow were not exercised end-to-end via UI due to time; backend /submit notif path already verified via curl.
